data_source.source_description: Country level-0 GADM 3.6 boundaries converted to unsimplified GeoJSON by community repo; not redistributed. Matches GADM3.6 version but exact equivalence to Barreto's island polygons not independently proven.

specified_decision.same_component: Both camera study center and original nearest heldout centroid are covered by the same single constituent Polygon of one GADM 3.6 country MULTIPOLYGON
specified_decision.different_component: Both covered in distinct polygons of the same source country polygon
specified_decision.one_or_both_outside: At least one camera study/heldout centroid not inside the frozen country geometry; do not equate outside with false island identity
specified_decision.ambiguous: Unexpected multiple overlapping polygons or unsupported geometry
